SELECT n.notification_id, n.user_id, u.name AS user_name, n.notification_type, n.title, n.message, n.send_channel, n.send_status, n.sent_at, n.read_yn, n.created_at FROM notifications n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.user_id
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT notification_id, user_id, notification_type, title, message, send_channel, send_status, sent_at, read_yn, created_at FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, notification_type, title, message, send_channel, send_status, sent_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{sendChannel}, #{sendStatus}, #{sentAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_yn = 'Y' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
